scripture.verse: Now He who has prepared us for this very thing is God, who has also given us the earnest of the Spirit.
Remember me, O Lord, with the favor that You have toward Your people; O visit me with Your salvation.
And for the good will of Him that dwelt in the bush.

Then He said to Thomas, Reach here your finger, and behold My hands; and reach here your hand, and thrust it into My side; and be not faithless, but believing. And Thomas answered, and said unto Him, My Lord and my God.

sermons.title: Sermon 3542 | A Precious Promise for a Pure People

scripture.verse: Your eyes will see the King in His beauty.
I have yet to speak on God's behalf.
Jesus said to Him, I am the way, the truth, and the life; no man comes to the Father but by Me.
And when He had thus spoken, He went on ahead, ascending up to Jerusalem.
Say unto my soul, I am your salvation.
